props.name: frames
props.description: Image URLs, one per frame, in order. Use this or `frameCount` with `drawFrame`.

props.name: drawFrame
props.description: Paints frame `index` into a blank canvas. Called once per frame up front, not on scroll.

props.name: frameSize
props.description: Pixel size generated frames are painted at.

props.name: length
props.description: How far the reader scrolls to play the whole sequence, as a CSS length.

props.name: pinHeight
props.description: Height of the pinned stage, as a CSS length. `100vh` for a full-screen hero.

props.name: fit
props.description: `cover` fills the stage and crops; `contain` shows the whole frame.

props.name: stillFrame
props.description: The frame shown under reduced motion. Defaults to the middle one.

props.name: label
props.description: Describes the sequence for assistive tech.

props.name: children
props.description: Laid over the stage. A function receives scroll progress from 0 to 1.

props.name: onProgress
props.description: Called with scroll progress from 0 to 1.
